segments.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question.
What does the computer industry thrive on apart from anarchy?
segments.translation: 除了无政府状态之外，计算机行业还靠什么蓬勃发展？

segments.text: Technology trends may push Silicon Valley back to the future.
segments.translation: 技术趋势可能会将硅谷推回未来。

segments.text: Carver Mead, a pioneer in integrated circuits and a professor of computer science at the California Institute of Technology, notes there are now workstations that enable engineers to design, test and produce chips right on their desks, much the way and editor creates a newsletter on a Macintosh.
segments.translation: 集成电路领域的先驱、加州理工学院的计算机科学教授卡弗·米德（ Carver Mead ）指出，现在有工作站可以让工程师直接在办公桌上设计、测试和生产芯片，这与编辑在Macintosh上创建时事通讯的方式大同小异。

segments.text: As the time and cost of making a chip drop to a few days and a few hundred dollars, engineers may soon be free to let their imaginations soar without being penalized by expensive failures.
segments.translation: 随着制造芯片的时间和成本降至几天和几百美元，工程师们可能很快就可以自由地发挥他们的想象力，而不会受到代价高昂的故障的影响。

segments.text: Mead predicts that inventors will be able to perfect powerful customized chips over a weekend at the office --
segments.translation: 米德预测，发明家将能够在一个周末的办公室里完善强大的定制芯片--

segments.text: spawning a new generation of garage start-ups and giving the U. S.  a jump on its foreign rivals in getting new products to market fast.
segments.translation: 催生了新一代的车库初创企业，并让美国在快速将新产品推向市场方面与外国竞争对手竞争。

segments.text: 'We've got more garages with smart people,' Mead observes. 'We really thrive on anarchy. '
segments.translation: 米德说： “我们有更多的车库，里面有聪明人。” “我们真的在无政府状态下茁壮成长。”

segments.text: And on Asians. Already, orientals and Asian Americans constitute the majority of the engineering staffs at many Valley firms.
segments.translation: 还有亚洲人。东方人和亚裔美国人已经占了许多山谷公司工程人员的大多数。

segments.text: And Chinese, Korean, Filipino and Indian engineers are graduating in droves from California's colleges.
segments.translation: 中国、韩国、菲律宾和印度的工程师正在成群结队地从加州的大学毕业。

segments.text: As the heads of next-generation start-ups, these Asian innovators can draw on customs and languages to forge tighter links with crucial Pacific Rim markets.
segments.translation: 作为下一代初创企业的负责人，这些亚洲创新者可以利用习俗和语言与关键的环太平洋市场建立更紧密的联系。

segments.text: For instance, Alex Au, a Stanford Ph. D. from Hong Kong, has set up a Taiwan factory to challenge Japan's near lock on the memory-chip market.
segments.translation: 例如， Alex Au ，斯坦福大学博士。D.来自香港，已经建立了一个台湾工厂，以挑战日本在存储器芯片市场的近乎锁定。

segments.text: India-born N. Damodar Reddy's tiny California company reopened an AT&T chip plant in Kansas City last spring with financing from the state of Missouri.
segments.translation: 去年春天，出生于印度的N. Damodar Reddy在加利福尼亚州的小公司在密苏里州的资助下，在堪萨斯城重新开设了一家AT&T芯片工厂。

segments.text: Before it becomes a retirement village, Silicon Valley may prove a classroom for building a global business.
segments.translation: 在成为退休村之前，硅谷可能会成为建立全球业务的教室。
